<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the signals in the typical aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm) are at 130.70, 130.27, 128.35, 126.66, 124.85, and 123.57 ppm, giving six distinct aromatic carbon signals. Therefore, the molecule contains six aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
